title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Ripple secures full MiCA license for crypto services across Europe
summary: The Luxembourg approval completes the company's MiCA licensing process, enabling it to provide regulated crypto-asset services across the European Economic Area.

title: Bitmine announces $74M Ether buys as chair says ‘greater chances of Clarity Act passage’
summary: Bitmine's big buy contrasts with crypto treasury peer Strategy, which reported selling millions of dollars worth of its Bitcoin holdings on Monday.

title: UN agency moves Stellar blockchain payment initiative beyond pilot stage
summary: The UN Development Programme said blockchain payment pilots in five countries cut costs, improved resilience and will now inform wider use across its humanitarian and development programs.

title: TeraWulf shares rise after $19B Anthropic AI lease, JV sale
summary: The Bitcoin miner signed a 20-year AI infrastructure lease with Anthropic and sold its majority stake in a separate AI data center joint venture.

title: Bitcoin price falls up to 4% on Strategy BTC sale as trader sees Summer 2022 repeat
summary: Bitcoin wiped out much of its latest gains thanks to a market reaction to Strategy's 3,600 BTC sell-off, but analysis eyed a potential buy announcement in the coming days.

title: FCA warns of major shakeup as AI agents meet tokenized money
summary: The FCA’s vision for agentic AI points toward a financial system where programmable money and tokenized assets could play a much larger role.

title: Crypto hacks fell 47% in H1 but ecosystem is no safer: CertiK
summary: Crypto exploits rose 59% quarter-on-quarter to $807.5 million in Q2, due partly to the KelpDAO and Drift Protocol exploits, which came at the hands of North Korean hackers.

title: Strategy sells 3,588 Bitcoin for $216M to fund dividends, keeps $2.55B reserve intact
summary: Strategy sold $216 million in Bitcoin to fund its dividend payments, as wealth manager Bernstein maintained its year-end Bitcoin price target of $150,000.

title: Belgian regulator flags 6 unauthorized crypto providers after MiCA deadline
summary: Belgium’s FSMA warned consumers about six crypto-asset service providers it added to a fraudulent CASP list days after the EU’s MiCA transitional period expired.
